parameters.description: Single original pixel art grassland terrain tile for a calm tactical board. Elevated orthographic camera49degrees, symmetric diamond top with width:height exactly4:3; about84x63 pixels, vertices at(48,8),(90,39),(48,71),(6,39). Very thin sidewall only4px. Soft dark desaturated gray-olive and earth-brown hues inspired by Into the Breach; NOT bright yellow green. Expert hand-placed coherent pixel clusters, restrained organic shape design, no noisy isolated pixels. No stones, flowers, cracks, checkerboard, decorative outline or grid on surface. No raised grass border or corner ornaments, no continuous strip along any edge. Detail contrast stays lower than character contrast. One full tile centered on transparent background, no cast shadow or floor. Earth with worn short grass: muted olive-brown ground is interwoven with TWO broad low-contrast irregular moss patches, partly broken by earth gaps. Grass mass should feel flat, natural and softly rounded, not a geometric crescent, stripe or island with a dark outline. A few short connected blades emerge from one patch. Quiet walkable center, no tall bush, no sharp light/dark texture. Balance plain ground and natural variation.
